batting.dismissal: c GJ Maxwell b KW Richardson

batting.dismissal: c Shahbaz Ahmed b Mohammed Siraj

batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b HV Patel

balls.text: yorker follows him down leg side, he can only get a drive out to long-on
full and just outside off, crunches another cover drive, straight to extra cover
swung away over deep midwicket! An overpitched slower ball, dipping into the slot. Gopal picks it, creates swinging room and clears the fielder with a clean swing
full and just outside off, sweetly driven along the floor to extra cover

AB settles under it, calls for it, takes it. Slower ball at a length outside off, Sakariya gets under that and looks to slog. Gets it high but about as far as where short leg would be. AB takes a long sprint and takes it

Morris groans as soon as he makes connection on this. It's a full toss at off stump, he's walked across the stumps for the ramp. But he doesn't get low enough, ends up cramping himself, and can only dab this to short fine. RCB's new bowling finisher gets RCB's former bowling finisher
picks out deep midwicket. Slower short ball just outside off, gets a decent connection on it but there's no pace to play with. It's also the longer side. And he finds the man there

lifted over the keeper! Walks into the off side because Siraj's angle is across off stump. Siraj responds with a bouncer and he adjusts, watches it closely, and whips this over the keeper after getting inside the line. Elicits a facepalm from Kohli
slower ball, short of a length and ripping away from the corridor. Slices his attempted slog over the bowler
carved over sweeper! Overpitched and wide outside off, right in the slot to clear his arms. And he times the opening of the face perfectly
short of a length at off stump, looks to place that into the off side, it drops pitch side
full and very wide outside off, too far to get bat on it
full at off stump, jammed towards mid-off
slapped over long-on! Jamieson's good outing ends with a bad delivery. Full toss at knee height, at leg stump, clears the front foot and swings cleanly
yorker outside off, clears the front leg and looks to drill that past mid-off. Can't manage to get decent bat on it
slower short ball wide outside off, left alone and deemed to be above head height by the square leg umpire
full and very wide outside off, beaten as he looks to chop through point
yorker at leg stump, jabbed out towards deep midwicket

just clears extra cover. Sundar runs backwards and to stretches out, but can't get a hand on it. Jamieson not too happy with that. He moved for that late. It's a slower ball, full and just outside off. Can't connect as he looks to launch it straight. Sliced
length at middle stump, pushed back towards the bowler
yorker length just outside off, jammed into the covers
carves it to the backward point boundary. Misses on the full toss, this is a full toss across off stump. Reaches out and slices it. Between point and short third
full ball just outside off, unleashes a monster drive along the floor but gets it straight to extra cover
yorker just outside off, jammed into the covers
yorker at off stump, jammed into the off side
yorker at middle stump, jammed out towards deep midwicket
high full toss, a slower ball, down leg side
dipping yorker outside off, jammed towards mid-off whose throw ends up at deep square. Tewatia wants a second, but he's sent back
slower short ball wide outside off, cut to sweeper cover
full and into leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket's right
short of a length outside off, chopped to sweeper

nicely taken by Maxwell running in. Length ball at leg stump, creates room and has a slog at it, but it's off the toe-end. Dipping quickly as Maxwell runs to the left at long-on and he has to get low very quickly to take this inches off the ground with a lunge. Dube's played his best IPL knock, falls short of a fifty
length ball across off stump, clears the front foot and has a swing at that. Leading edge flies past short third
slower ball at a length wide outside off, slapped to sweeper's right
length at middle stump, punched to long-on
reverse swat well to sweeper's right. Length and fired in flat middle stump, gets a nice swing at this after jumping into it
short of a length just outside off, punched to extra cover off the back foot
short of a length just outside off, sliced to point's left
length at off stump, defended into the covers on the front foot
length and sliding past leg stump as he clears the front leg and looks to slog that
tickled past the keeper. Full and at leg stump, shuffles and exposes leg stump a little - gives the bowler a sliver of hope - before getting enough bat on the flick to get that fine
slower yorker gone wrong, wide outside off and left alone
trademark Tewatia. Short of a length and rising at leg stump, languid swing of the bat from under the ball, picks it up off his hip and places it over fine leg
full and wide outside off, left alone

looks to ramp over short fine, gets caught at third man. Can't fault him for one thing - the ball was there for the ramp; But it's off the leading edge. Length ball outside off, drops into the off side to get behind it and manages it. But closes the face too soon. An annoyed Harshal shows him the way to the dugout
helicopter! Full and into leg stump, clears the front leg and gives this some serious whippage! Along the floor and between deep midwicket and long-on
short of a length just outside off, looks to pull over midwicket. Comes on quick and he ends up slicing to long-on

Kohli nearly plucks a blinder at extra cover! Length ball outside off, leans in and checks his drive because the ball gets big on him. Kohli flies low to his right and gets one hand on it, can't hold on
short of a length outside off, punched to point's left
short of a length outside off, waits for it to come on and chops it to third man's left
length and into leg stump, clipped to deep square
lofted over extra cover. Length ball outside off, half a stride out and swings his arms through this, all bottom-hand this, the bat face is well open. Kept his balance nicely
short of a length just outside off, punched to point off the back foot

lifts it past short third! Strange change, that. Dube's scoring against pace has almost exclusively been in that region and they've brought the fielder in. Stranger that he's bowled a short one in the corridor
full slower ball wide outside off, left alone
yorker length at off stump, jammed into the covers
full and into middle stump, leans in and flicks to long-on

misfield by Siraj at sweeper cover. Miscue from Parag first. Length ball wide outside off, chucks his hands at that so hard, one of them's come off the bat. Ends up slicing to sweeper's left. Siraj sprints and over-runs it. Has ended up out of position, neither attempts to stop, nor looks to catch, just lets it go
slashes hard and that flies past the keeper. Short of a length outside off, room to swing his arms and he looks to blaze that behind point
slower ball, short of a length and just outside off. Jabbed to third man
flies past the outside edge. Short of a length in the corridor, gets tight on him as he shapes to play the late cut and he gets caught in an awkward position
short and just outside off, sliced with the angle to third man
nonchalantly ramped over where slip would've been. Short and rising in the corridor, but rising gently. Arches back and creates a ramp for that
short of a length outside off, waits on that and steers to third man
short outside off, cut firmly to sweeper point
driven on the up past mid-off. Length ball climbing away from off stump, comes on nicely and he doesn't try to keep this down. Four from between partner and mid-off
short and just outside off, chopped to sweeper's right
short of a length and rising into the hips, waits on it and jabs it through square leg
short of a length at leg stump, nudged to deep square off the back foot
length outside off and turning in, punched to long-on off the back foot
length and into off stump, deep in the crease to whip to long-on
short of a length at middle stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
length and turning into off stump, deep in the crease to flick to midwicket
length outside off, catches the outside edge as he pushes inside the line of this

slogged over long-on again! Chahal's gone around the wicket and taken the fear of a googly out of Dube's mind here I think. This is a legbreak, turning into his arc from outside off, and he gets down on a knee and swings cleanly
short of a length and wide outside off, left alone
beaten on the slog sweep and AB can't even get a hand on it. Length ball turning in from outside off, turns and bounces too
drilled! Full at off stump, clears the front leg and nails this. Does this a lot in this stadium in domestic cricket
good length and turning into middles stump, punched back to the bowler off the back foot
short of a length and turning into leg stump, clipped to deep square's left off the back foot
full on off stump, driven with the turn to long-off
length at middle stump, defended on the front foot
length outside off, driven on the rise to long-off

chipped straight to midwicket! That comes on slow and Samson can't keep it down. Short of a length, turning into the pads. Wants to whip that through vacant midwicket for a single. But that sticks and gets big on him and can only get that to Maxwell's left for a simple take
pumped over deep midwicket. Length ball at middle stump, steps out to get to the pitch and goes clean, with the spin
length at leg stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
length at leg stump, glanced to deep backward square's left
good length, turning away outside off. Driven to extra's left
full at middle stump, leans in and flicks to short midwicket's left
length at leg stump, punched off the back foot to long-on
legbreak from off stump, turned into midwicket off the back foot
flies past the outside edge. Short of a length and really slammed into the pitch. Across the corridor and past his angled bat
short at off stump, defended off the back foot
short of a length and into off stump. Opens the face and runs it to deep backward point's left
length at off stump, defended down the pitch

controlled dab for four. Samson looks focused tonight. Short of a length delivery outside off, there is width for the cut. But he's played it safe, straighter bat, opens the face late and runs it between backward point and short third
full and down leg side, beaten on the flick
suh-weeet. Length ball outside off, cross seam. Gets forward nicely, leans into it, holds a lovely shape as he punches to mid-off's left
length and just outside off, blocked on the front foot
easily put away. Short of a length outside off, waits on that and gives it a late jab with an open face. Past cover
yorker length at middle stump, 140kph, jammed towards mid-on

massive lbw appeal and Kohli reviews. Miller is surprised by the yorker and looks to block it. It gets his bat and rolls out to mid-off, but did it hit his shoe first? It looks like it on first review...and the ball was vey full, it's likely to have pitched in line. It has! That decision will be overturned. A great review, and a great ball. Miller had no idea that was coming. Full and headed for middle and leg stump. Head falling over and foot planted right across the stumps. The move to bat him 4 hasn't worked
good length and just outside off, blocked on the front foot
full and into the stumps, driven along the floor to mid-on's left
good length in the corridor, blocked towards mid-off and hares for the run

taken by mid-on running to the left! Length ball outside off, Vohra wants to pump that over mid-on. He's not to the pitch of that and it gets big on him. It comes off the toe-end and Richardson tracks back to take that
short of a length at middle stump, punched to mid-on's right off the back foot
beaten on the cut Short and climbing outside off, was arching back and looking to slice that over first slip
full at middle stump, a sweet little drive with the angle, straight to mid-on
length at off stump, punched to mid-off's left to steal the run
length and just outside off, nicely forward and punched to mid-off
length ball outside off, left alone
slower ball at a length at off stump, defended into the covers

hits the top of leg stump! Buttler walks into the leg side and misses on this punch. Short of a length and slanted into leg stump. Not too different from the ball he hit through square leg last over, after walking into the off side. This time he's a long way down leg side with the stumps exposed and he misses the ball
good length and at off stump, punched to extra cover
full and just outside off, gets his weight into this drive but can't beat Kohli's dive to the right at extra cover
short of a length just outside off, dropped fine of point with soft hands
meets it with a pull this time. Short ball outside off, springs up quickly on his front foot press and pulls aerially to the midwicket boundary
short of a length, slammed into the pitch and seaming away from the outside edge as Vohra pokes at that
length outside off, jabs at that on the front foot and is caught inside the line, beaten
beaten on the pull. Compulsive on that shot, Vohra. Hit a four and was caught playing the same shot next ball against CSK. This time he can't connect as that rises in the corridor
good length outside off, stays inside the line of that and lets it go
oh lovely! He's sized up the pitch, and the length from Siraj. Shuffles and walks down the pitch outside off, takes this incoming delivery off his hips, gets it past midwicket with a nudge
clears midwicket and sprints away. Length ball outside of, looks to slam it through the covers on the rise. The bat turns in his hands and this flies off the inside half
cuts through him! Slammed at a length, 137kph, just outside off. Hits the seam and beats Buttler on the inside edge as he looks to drive on the rise
short of a length and rising into the corridor. Pulls out of a drive on the rise, pats it into the covers
good length and headed for the top of off. Solidly forward to block this
full and in at middle stump, searching for some swing no doubt. But this goes on straight. Pushed out to mid-on
full and down leg and past the keeper. He's beaten on the flick, Samson's beaten on the dive to his right
slower ball at a length on middle stump, punched to extra cover's left
we have a review for lbw here. He's copped a full toss on the pad, but that looked to hit him outside leg stump as he was beaten on the flick. Yes, hitting outside leg, going down leg

drills it past extra cover and brings up his maiden IPL hundred! Pristine drive to cap off a pristine innings. This is just outside off, his front leg is out of the way and he goes inside-out, all along the floor, to the fielder's left. His team-mates are on their feet. Another milestone in a fairytale career
short of a length and he walks into this, trying to clip through square. Cops it on the body
low full toss at leg stump, short-arm whip to long-on's left and they only take a single
slower ball at a length just outside off, shuffles and opens the face to run this to short third
yorker at leg stump, jammed out towards wide long-on

edged and over short third! Possibly the first boundary he's miscued. Full and just outside off, clears the front leg and has a big hoick across the line and ends up looking a little silly. But he's earned the right to do that tonight
slower ball at a length outside off, steps out and slaps this to sweeper's right
sliced straight to short third! Low full toss just outside off, allows that on and opens the face. A yard either side and that was four
searing yorker at middle and leg, dips in late. Manages to jam it out
low full toss outside off, toe-ended drive to long-on
beaten. Offcutter at a length, grips and turns past the outside edge as he looks to drive on the up
slower ball, short and just outside off. Looks to pull and miscues. Sliced to long-on's right
yorker length at off stump, steps out and jabs it into the covers
length at middle stump, deep in the crease to drop this into midwicket with soft hands
dropped short again and punished  again. Legbreak wide outside off, waits on it and cuts powerfully to sweeper's left
googly, short of a length at leg stump, punched to deep midwicket off the back foot
reverse pull over short third! Swivels, presumably for the googly, from his domestic team-mate. It's a legbreak that meets him. But it is so short, he can get this away from off stump
short and turning away outside off, reaches out and punches to long-off
pulled flat and firmly to deep midwicket's left! Dropped short at off stump, in position quickly and sent on its way
low full toss just outside off, driven to extra cover off the toe-end
length outside off, punched on the rise to sweeper cover
full toss on the pads, stands tall and whips that fine of long leg to bring up 6000 runs in the IPL. The first batter do that
slower ball at a length on off stump, drops it into the off side with soft hands
dipping full toss at off stump, shuffles and pats this to mid-on to bring up his first fifty of the season
slaps it over mid-off! You know the timing is back when Kohli brings this shot out. Slower ball at a length outside off, lots of room and he stretches out and slaps it on the up
slower short ball outside off, under-edge on the pull to deep square
oh too simple. Short and just outside off, steps out and simply uses the pace to slice this past point. Sweeper is too straight to stop this to his left
slower short ball outside off, looks for the pull and is through it early. Misses and Samson gets an awkward bounce that he can only deflect off the pads
short of a length just outside off, steps out and opens the face to run this to point
full slower ball at leg stump, from around the wicket. Uses the angle on that to flick past short fine
short of a length at off stump, flicked to deep square
short outside off, shuffles and is late on a pull. But it's well to deep midwicket's left and they get two
short and across off stump, looks to cut but that comes on quickly. Gently out to sweeper cover
full at leg stump, driven to mid-on. Whose throw is not backed up by Dube at point and gives them an extra run at third man
nearly sneaks through Kohli. Yorker speared in at leg stump. Kohli exposes the stumps and has a flap at this. Thick inside edge to fine leg
second four for Kohli. Short ball just outside off, shuffles and shapes to pull. Just a touch early into it but adjusts brilliantly to rolls the wrists and get this to deep square's left
slower short ball outside off, makes room to try and get that past the off-side infielders. Under edge to extra cover on the cut
slower ball at a length, steps out and drives firmly on the rise. Morris does superbly to slide to his right at long-off and stop one-handed
slower ball at a length outside off, backs away, mistimes the slog towards long-on
pulled over deep square leg! Short and coming in at middle stump, swivels and picks it up off the back foot. Sweet, sweet timing
short and up at the chest, late on the pull, trickles out to deep square
short of a length and into off stump, stabs it to extra cover's right and pinches the run. Tewatia would have got him with a direct hit
short of a length outside off, steps out and drives to long-off

slog sweep nailed off the middle. Whew. Everything coming out the middle tonight. Length outside off, he's around the wicket and turning it into the sweeping arc. Padikkal gets down quickly and hits the electronic board in the leg side
steps out and gets this over the bowler. Flat, this time. Length outside off, gets to the pitch of this and a short-arm swing to send this into the ad board
full at off stump, driven with the turn to long-off
short of a length and turning in from outside off, cut to point
short and just outside off, punched straight to extra cover
short outside off, backs away and cuts to sweeper cover
see ya! There's no stopping this guy right now. It's full and drifted into him from around the wicket. Right to the pitch of that and swung to the left of the sightscreen
full and just outside off, steps out and drills to sweeper's right
length at middle stump, punched to long-on
caressed over extra cover for the fifty. Parag goes side-arm, drops a friendly one at driving length outside off. Padikkal leans in and uses quick wrists to find the gap
full and into leg stump, flicked to deep midwicket
full outside off, driven firmly to long-off
short of a length just outside off, late cut to backward point's left, can't sneak a run
length outside off, punched down to long-off off the back foot
length at middle stump, punched to long-on off the back foot
legbreak, short of a length and turning into off stump. Punched hurriedly to extra cover's right
dropped short and wide, waits on it and places the cut to sweeper's right
short and into leg stump, steps out and pulls to deep square

lifts it over the wide long-on boundary! Gets a big cheer from Kohli at the other end. Overpitched delivery at off stump, holds his shape again, half a stride, and gets his hands languidly through the line of this for the pick-up six
length and wide outside off, left alone
slower ball, short of a length outside off. Opens the face and stabs to short third
full outside off, steps out and yorks himself. Jams this to mid-on
short at middle stump, drops the right shoulder and looks to hook. Late on it
short of a length and cutting into the body. Hurriedly drops it pitch side with soft hands
slower ball at a length on off stump, defended into the off side with soft hands

sweet flowing drive to clear the long-off boundary! Whew, it had been tough going in Chepauk for Padikkal, but the ball coming on is tailor made for him. He's jumped at this surface. Length ball just outside off, half a stride out and a strong shape as he extends his arms on this straight drive and lifts it
length at middle stump, flicked to midwicket

Mustafiz stops it with his left hand. Overpitched ball at middle stump, driven firmly and aerially between non-striker and stumps. He reacts by sticking out a hand, his left one, even as he falls towards his right in the follow through. Saves four
oh lovely game awareness this. Full ball outside off, takes a little step into the off side to get behind the line and flicks this behind square, where it runs past short fine
short and just outside off, classy looking square cut, but straight to backward point
full slower ball outside off, looks to drill through cover and gets it to mid-on off the inside half
full and down leg side, shuffles and flicks that past short fine
slower ball at a length on off stump, opens the face and runs to third man off the front foot
leading edge safely in front of sweeper. Short of a length and outside off, walks down at it and looks to turn it into the leg side. That gets big on him
full at middle and leg, driven straight to mid-on
cut over point! Short and just outside off, not a lot of room but he's got quick hands and he doesn't try to keep this down
nicely placed. Short of a length and across him, not the delivery for this field. Opens the face and runs it between point and short third
front-of-the-hand delivery at length, on leg stump. Flicked to deep midwicket
short of a length slider outside off, chopped straight to point
swiped past short fine! In control of the sweep this time. It's a googly, at a length and outside leg stump, doesn't trouble him at all
short and turning into middle stump, backs away and cuts fiercely, but straight to cover point
full at middle stump, very late decision to sweep it seems. Hurries into it and gets a thick inside edge past short fine
short of a length and turning away outside off, punched to long-on off the back foot
slower ball at a length outside off, opens the face and steers straight to short third
length and into the pad as he looks to flick, Sanju the only one appealing for lbw. That might have been going down
whipped through vacant midwicket. Short of a length and following him down leg side. brings out the flick with no attempt to keep it down
short outside off, shuffles and cramps himself on the cut a little. Out to sweeper's right
short of a length outside off, opens the face and chops to short third
short of a length, some shape away outside off. Jabbed to point from the crease
googly, short of a length and wide outside off. Pushed down the pitch off the inside half
googly, short of a length and into leg stump, whipped to deep square's right

steps out and drills it over mid-on! He's gotten out to him, yes, but he also takes runs off him. This is length at middle stump, he steps out confidently to the pitch of this and gets a neat connection
googly, length and outside off. Kohli extends the arms to try and drive through the covers. Gets that on the sticker
legbreak at a length on off stump, blocked on the front foot
googly, very short and down leg side. Looks to pull and is through it early, cops it on the pad
